sections.Profile:
The "Lost World: Jurassic Park" pinball machine, released by Sega in 1997, was designed by John Borg and is based on the film of the same name. This machine features a range of engaging gameplay elements, including two flippers, three pop bumpers, two ramps, and a unique "Snagger" mechanism designed to capture and lock balls, enhancing the multiball experience.
